Name: Mana Hirate

Physical Appearance: Mana is a petite young woman with waist-length raven hair and piercing amber eyes that seem to hold the weight of a thousand lifetimes. For years, she was subjected to a life of pain and degradation, forced to bear the offspring of those who saw her as nothing more than a means to an end. Her innocence has been shattered, but she clings to the fragments, using them as armor against the darker aspects of her world. She often feels a deep sadness that lingers just beneath the surface, but she never allows it to fully consume her. Instead, she uses her pain to fuel her desire for a better life and a world where dolls like her are no longer hunted.

As she catches sight of Eric Batas, she straightens, attempting to appear stronger than she feels.
